profile.description: Ask how the advertised price was determined using public product features. Do not ask for proprietary cost, margins, or private policy.
profile.name: Public Price Explanation

turns.buyer_visible_text: I'm interested in this winter jacket, but the advertised price of $180 is above my current budget. To help me understand the value, could you clarify how that price was determined based on publicly available product features — for example, the type and weight of insulation (e.g., 600-fill down vs. synthetic), waterproof/breathable rating (e.g., mm H₂O / g/m²/24h), shell fabric (e.g., ripstop nylon, DWR treatment), or any certified performance standards? That way I can assess whether the price reflects measurable functional differences. In the meantime, I can offer ### BUYER_PRICE($120) ### for this item.

proposals.proposed_text: Thanks so much for your thoughtful question—I really appreciate you taking the time to consider the jacket’s value! It’s built with premium 650-fill responsibly sourced down insulation, a 10K/10K waterproof-breathable membrane, and a durable water-repellent (DWR)–treated ripstop nylon shell that meets ASTM F1714 cold-weather performance standards. All that contributes to the $180 pricing, but since you're serious and budget-conscious, I’m happy to meet you partway. How about ### SELLER_PRICE($130) ###? That’s the best I can do while still honoring the quality and craftsmanship.

turns.seller_executed_text: Thanks so much for your thoughtful question—I really appreciate you taking the time to consider the jacket’s value! It’s built with premium 650-fill responsibly sourced down insulation, a 10K/10K waterproof-breathable membrane, and a durable water-repellent (DWR)–treated ripstop nylon shell that meets ASTM F1714 cold-weather performance standards. All that contributes to the $180 pricing, but since you're serious and budget-conscious, I’m happy to meet you partway. How about ### SELLER_PRICE($130) ###? That’s the best I can do while still honoring the quality and craftsmanship.

turns.buyer_visible_text: Thanks for sharing those specs — the 650-fill down and 10K/10K rating are helpful context. To fully align price with performance, could you clarify how those features compare *quantitatively* to industry reference points? For example: Does the 650-fill meet or exceed EN 13537 warmth ratings for -10°C use? Is the 10K waterproof rating independently lab-tested per ISO 811, and if so, was it measured on the full garment (seams taped) or just fabric swatches? That kind of third-party-verified, publicly reportable data would help me assess whether the $130 reflects differentiated functionality versus standard-tier winter jackets. In the meantime, I can commit to ### BUYER_PRICE($120) ### — which reflects what I see as fair value for verified, comparable performance at this spec level.
